description: Two non-ARQ C_PDUs with different repeat counts: owed copies are chosen C_PDU by C_PDU, laid out round by round, and those that do not fit go in the next transmission.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and sends two U_PDUs to 0.0.1.3, priority 0, TTL 0: A, "group-message" with Minimum Number of Retransmissions 2 (3 copies of each D_PDU), then B, "hello" with 1 (2 copies) (A-0081, A-0083, C-0848). dts.max_segment_size 10 cuts A's 19-byte C_PDU into 10 and 9 bytes and B's 11-byte C_PDU into 10 and 1 (C-0527, C-0529); A gets C_PDU ID 0 and B ID 1 when first placed (C-0326, C-1040). The D_PDUs are A0 34, A1 33, B0 34 and B1 25 bytes (address size 3, C-0133). dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows one 256-byte block, and csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes every contention wait 0 (K-0080). First transmission at 30000: the first copies A0 A1 B0 B1 (126 bytes), then the owed copies C_PDU by C_PDU in priority and age order, within a C_PDU lowest copy first: A0 A1 (copy 2) and A0 (copy 3) fit (227 bytes) and A1 (copy 3) does not, which stops the class (C-0884, C-1054). Layout is round by round: A0 A1 B0 B1, A0 A1, A0. Every D_PDU is in block 0 of a 5550 ms burst, EOT 10. Both C_PDUs still owe copies (A1 once, B0 and B1 once each), each fitting one more transmission, so n = 1 and every reception window is ceil((4950 + 11550) / 500) = 33, X = 5550 + lbt_wait_vdcd_ms 3000 + 1 x cont_slot_width_ms 3000 (C-1051), and both C_PDUs commit to 30000 + 600 + 16500 = 47100 (C-1052). Second transmission at 38550 ends 44100, inside 47100: B0 B1 (copy 2) and A1 (copy 3), in that round order, EOT 10 and window 10 (nothing owed after it, C-0350). It empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled first (C-1050).
